newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE July canola up on export, new crop down on CBT.
newsitem.headline: WCE July canola up on export, new crop down on CBT.

text.p: WCE canola traded up in old crop on high exports while new crop followed CBOT soycomplex.

"XCan, Mitsui and Cargill did 13,000 to 15,000 tonnes of business to Japan," a trader said. "PCTS and UGG were scale up sellers of the July and Cargill was buying Nov," another trader said. July WCE futures crush margin fell to -1.67 Tuesday from +0.34 Monday. Sept-Nov spread at $3.50.
Japan bought 13,000-15,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
July canola rose $2.40 to $404.50 at 1100 CDT, November down $0.40 to $374.50. July flax traded unchanged at $333 as commercials bought to cover old exports, 50 Sep-Nov spread $2.

July western barley lost $1.50 to $133.60 on commercial and commission selling, October fell $1.10 to $134.20, 100 July-Oct spread at $0.50 with Alberta Wheat Pool a featured seller. Volume was good. Oats did not trade.
July feed wheat lost $1 to $158.20 in light commercial selling, December lost $0.60 to $159.40. July-Dec was offered at $1.
PCTS sold five October feed pea contracts unchanged at US$186 to a commercial, a trader said.
(All prices in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats, peas).
